subject: Urgent: Pinegrove API latency surge — coordination and mitigation
messages:
From: Ana Silva <ana.silva@pinegrove.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: API slowed dramatically - urgent

Hi Kimberly,

We started seeing a big deterioration across our Redwood API calls around 08:50 PDT. p95 latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.2s and our throughput fell by ~25%. Error rates look stable but timeouts are starting to appear in our logs. This is impacting checkout flows.

Attached is a screenshot from our monitoring (screenshot_error_payload.png). Can you confirm whether any routing or model changes were pushed around 08:45–09:00? We need immediate mitigation and a clear ETA.

Thanks,
Ana Silva
Head of Platform Engineering | Pinegrove Retail
ana.silva@pinegrove.com

Subject: RE: API slowed dramatically - urgent

Thanks Ana — sorry for the disruption. Looping eng + SRE + CS to triage. High level: Pinegrove is seeing a p95 jump and throughput dip, suspected routing/kernel change at ~08:50.

Immediate asks:
- Ben/Tessa: can you confirm whether a kernel/serving change rolled at ~08:45–09:00? Any quick mitigations (rollback, route override) you can enact? Please advise estimated ETA.
- Marissa: FYI on product/roadmap implications — if this is a kernel regression we need to decide safe rollout controls.
- Grace: can you prep a short customer note (one-paragraph) we can send once we have an ETA?

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, Ana Silva <ana.silva@pinegrove.com>
Date: 2028-03-29T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: API slowed dramatically - urgent

Quick tech update from runtime side — observed a sharp increase in per-token kernel L2 hits for the new attention kernel we rolled at 08:50 in us-west-2. Average token time for large-sequence requests rose ~8–10x on a subset of hardware (NVIDIA-X1-family). That aligns with the start time Ana reported.

Mitigations we can take now:
1) Roll back the kernel change to previous stable binary on the affected fleet (can push in 1–2 waves, estimated 25–30 minutes to reach full coverage).
2) If product approves, temporarily route Pinegrove traffic to our reserved/dedicated capacity for them (we have headroom) — avoids multi-tenant kernel exposure.
3) Enable protective fallback to the quantized model variant for their highest-latency endpoints (minor accuracy tradeoff).

I'd prioritize (1) + (2) in parallel. I'll prepare the rollback job and the routing rule; Tessa, can SRE run the rollback at 10:25 if we give the go?

Commands I will run (ops):
- rollout set kernel:stable --selector fleet=us-west-2 --force
- routing rule add --account pinegrove --pool dedicated-pool-3 --priority 900

Attaching p95-metrics.csv for the last 90 minutes.

-ben
Ben Carter
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
ben_carter@redwood.com
